title: Marketplace partner daily scratchpad — Jordan Hsu
content:
Morning scratchpad — quick brain dump (3/12)

Top 3 for today:
- [ ] Confirm Atlas Data billing model for marketplace listing
- [ ] Get eng review on Cobalt Health integration PR (#1234) + unblock e2e test
- [ ] Draft partner-facing one-pager for vendor enablement call on Fri

Partner-specific notes
1) Cobalt Health (HCP marketplace)
- Today: sync 11:00am PT. Goal: confirm telemetry payloads + rate limits.
- Integration checklist items to confirm:
  - API auth: will use API-key scoped to "marketplace-proxy" service
  - Required fields: organization_id, model_id, request_id, token_count
  - Billing: meter tokens at host-level; partner needs separate billing account?
  - Example curl + sample prompt (I need to attach sample responses)
- Blockers: Eng needs clarification on JWT audience claim -> ping @selene
- Next steps:
  - Action (Jordan): add example payload to Confluence (PRIME-342)
  - Action (Priya): draft legal terms summary for MSA conversation

2) Atlas Data (analytics vendor)
- Partner wants a soft launch week of Apr 6; need marketplace listing ready Apr 1.
- Marketplace checklist (quick):
  - [ ] Logo + 120x40 compressed PNG
  - [ ] Short description (<= 280 chars)
  - [ ] Technical integration doc + OpenAPI snippet
  - [ ] SLA & support contact
  - [ ] Billing mapping + pricing tier suggestion
  - [ ] Security questionnaire answered
- Tech notes: they asked for a webhook for post-usage callbacks. Confirm retry/backoff policy.

Operational reminders
- Add tracking tag UTM=marketplace-alpha to demo invites
- Prepare recording for demo (15m) and upload to drive before Fri
- Create Linear ticket for post-launch telemetry (LP-789)

Meetings
- 11:00 Cobalt sync (Zoom link in invite)
- 2:30 PM internal eng handoff (async notes in CONFLUENCE:PRIME-342)
- 4:00 PM GTM huddle (update on Atlas timeline)

Quick hits / notes to self
- When pushing docs to marketplace, double-check image alt text for accessibility
- If we require KMS, mention Redwood Private option in the doc
- Consider offering migration assistance (2-hour onboarding session) as paid add-on
- Follow up with Jonah (Legal) re: MSA redline; deadline EOD Thu

Unresolved questions
- Is partner ok with our default 99.9% SLO or do they need stricter? (ask in call)
- Do we need to create a dedicated dedicated-infra pool for heavy batch jobs?

Local todo list (short)
- finish sample payload + attach to PRIME-342
- ping selene about JWT audience claim
- upload Atlas logo + draft listing copy
- create demo recording + upload

End-of-day check
- reflect on what unblocked, what still blocked, and update LP tickets
- mark done items in this doc and copy final checklist to shared drive

Random quick note:
- If Atlas wants a private deployment test, scope estimate = 3-4 dev days + infra
